name: Rinn-chan no Tensei Hakusho ~Meido no Miyagebanashi~
original_name: Rinn's転生白書～冥土のみやげばなし～
source:
Rinn-chan is a 14-year-old junior high school student who suddenly dies before confessing to her love interest. At the heavens she meets an angel and three other girls. Angel agrees to return Rinn-chan to the Earth due to unnatural cause of her death. She may choose one of the three girls to reincarnate and confess to her love or choose no one and go back as herself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
凛酱是名14岁的初中生，在向心上人告白前突然死亡。她在天堂遇见一名天使和另外三个女孩。由于凛酱的死因不自然，天使同意让她回到人间。她可以选择三个女孩中的一人转生并向心上人告白，也可以谁都不选，以自己的身份返回人间。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
